about_pullquote: I take pride in getting the details right and leaving every home better than I found it.
about_para_1: Ervin Hoxha has been decorating homes and businesses across Newcastle for over 15 years. His background in both interior and exterior finishing means he understands how colour, preparation, and technique come together to create work that looks sharp and lasts. Whether it's a single bedroom refresh or a full house redecoration, Ervin brings the same level of care and professionalism to every job.
about_para_2: Customers return to Ervin because he listens to what they want, prepares surfaces properly, and takes his time to get the finish right. He sources quality materials, respects your home, and keeps disruption to a minimum. No shortcuts, no high-pressure selling—just honest, skilled decorating at fair prices.

reviews.text: Ervin painted our lounge and hallway last month. He was punctual, tidy, and the finish is immaculate. He even moved furniture carefully and cleaned up properly at the end. Would definitely recommend him.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had our whole house redecorated inside. Ervin gave a fair quote, stuck to timeline, and the work is brilliant. Professional throughout and left the place spotless. Will call him for the outside next spring.
reviews.author: Lisa J.

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our feature wall. Ervin took time to explain colour options and prep was spot on. The finish is smooth and perfect. Highly recommend for anyone after a decorator who cares about quality.
reviews.author: David M.
